## Checklist (Definition of Done, see CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] CI is green
- [ ] Tests added / updated (regression test for every bug fix)
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or real user content in code, tests or logs
- [ ] Migrations committed (if models changed)
- [ ] Docs updated: branch README, `CHANGELOG.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, `sample_env.txt`, ADR (if architectural)
- [ ] Breaking changes listed with upgrade steps (or: no breaking changes)
